content: Hi everyone ranking Hegotá EIPs, if you have ranked, post your ranking at the Hegotá EIP [thread](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-8081-hegota-network-upgrade-meta-thread/26876) as the canonical (central) place for these rankings and the collection of those.
